walk_summary: Start by the dark-headboard-bed and walk across the fluffy-white-rug past the tall-dark-dresser toward the black-nightstand and sheer-curtain-window, turning right to face the grey-dresser-with-plant.
Turn left and exit through the six-panel-door-to-railing onto the carpeted passage beside the upper-stair-railing, passing the doorway to the teal-pillow-bed on the left.
Turn right by the upper-stair-railing and walk down the carpeted-winding-stairs past the framed-easel-print and stair-bottom-door onto the hardwood floor facing the wooden-dining-table.
Walk forward with the wooden-dining-table on the left and pass the dark-wood-corner-cabinet into the tiled area by the stainless-stove.

Step back onto the hardwood floor past the wooden-dining-table, walk toward the wide-double-window, and turn right to face the grey-ottoman, red-pillow-sofa, accent-chair-red-pillow, and round-wall-decor.
Turn right and walk past the wooden-dining-table and tiger-print on the left to face the stair-bottom-door and carpeted-winding-stairs.
Turn left past the tiger-print and walk down the two-wood-steps beneath the metal-butterfly-art, passing the vanity-with-mirror on the right to reach the double-glass-entry-door.
Turn around at the double-glass-entry-door, pass the white-toilet and metal-butterfly-art on the left, and climb the two-wood-steps back toward the wooden-dining-table.
Go down the narrow enclosed staircase under the sloped-stair-ceiling, then turn around and return to the main level.
Pass the wooden-dining-table on the right and stair-bottom-door on the left, and climb the carpeted-winding-stairs alongside the upper-stair-railing toward the teal-pillow-bed.
At the top of the carpeted-winding-stairs, turn right to face the six-panel-door-to-railing and dark-headboard-bed with the white-tiled-tub on the right.
Turn left and walk into the area under the ceiling-fan-light with the dark-bedding-bed ahead and dark-tall-chest on the right.
Turn left and walk into the adjacent area past the teal-pillow-bed and flower-wall-art on the left to the wooden-nightstand-lamp and sheer-curtain-window-2.
Turn around, walk past the teal-pillow-bed on the right, and cross straight into the area with the dark-bedding-bed, passing the wall-mounted-tv-shelf on the left.
Turn around and walk out past the dark-tall-chest and dark-bedding-bed on the left and wall-mounted-tv-shelf on the right toward the upper-stair-railing and dark-headboard-bed.
Turn left along the upper-stair-railing and walk down the carpeted-winding-stairs past the framed-easel-print.

At the bottom of the stairs, walk forward between the wooden-dining-table and tiger-print on the right and the accent-chair-red-pillow, grey-ottoman, and red-pillow-sofa on the left toward the round-wall-decor and small-wooden-buffet.
Turn around to face the carpeted-winding-stairs with the wooden-dining-table on the left and accent-chair-red-pillow and tv-on-wooden-console on the right.
Turn right, walk past the tv-on-wooden-console on the left and grey-ottoman on the right to the wide-double-window, and turn right to face the red-pillow-sofa.

Turn around, walk across the hardwood floor past the wooden-dining-table on the left, and continue past the stainless-stove, wooden-kitchen-cabinets, and drop-leaf-table on the left and floral-canvas-prints on the right to the sliding-glass-patio-door.
